Subject: Physics
Type: scq (single correct option)

Question:
Two blocks of masses 10 kg and 4 kg are connected by a spring of negligible mass and placed on a frictionless horizontal surface. An impulse gives a velocity of 14 m/s to the heavier block in the direction of the lighter block. The velocity of the centre of mass is

Options:
(A) 30 m/s
(B) 20 m/s
(C) 10 m/s
(D) [this option is missing]

text:
```json
{
 "answer": "C",
 "value": "10 m/s",
 "working": "Velocity of the center of mass V_cm = (m1 * v1 + m2 * v2) / (m1 + m2)\nHere, m1 = 10 kg, v1 = 14 m/s, m2 = 4 kg, v2 = 0 m/s\nV_cm = (10 * 14 + 4 * 0) / (10 + 4) = 140 / 14 = 10 m/s",
 "confidence": 1.0,
 "issues": []
}
```
